description: POST /sessions/{id}/action: one step. x and y with coords "screenshot" are pixels on the latest screenshot, which the host scales back to the page. A point wins over an element when a step has both. A step settles before the host answers. When it started a main-frame request or a navigation, or changed the page in place, the host waits until those requests are done, no shown element is marked aria-busy and the page has shown no change for settle_quiet_ms, at most settle_max_ms (a navigation also waits for its new page's network, as before). After an in-place change that started nothing, a host may stop sooner, so a page that changes on its own (a ticker) doesn't hold every step to the cap. A step that changed nothing and started neither answers at once, though a host may first wait out a page marked aria-busy. changed says whether the step changed what the page shows: true, false, or null when the host can't tell (a frame, canvas or media element in view or under the step, a closed shadow root, a hover, a wait, a read, or a page it couldn't watch). The answer carries the page after the step when include_page is true. into_frame is true only when the person approved this one step on a card and its point may land in a frame, whatever held it.The desktop app's browser, which holds no steps itself, refuses (409) a press, or a drag's release, that lands in a frame when into_frame is false or missing; the router's browser holds its own steps and ignores it.
